ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms acceptance cases, change scope and compatibility notes are declared; it does not show the implemented feature meets them.
offer: Name observable outcomes before touching source. Keep the change inside the agreed files, and make compatibility expectations explicit.

minimal.reason: Write the observable acceptance cases before touching source. An empty list means no outcome defines done, so name what a user or caller will see.

mid.reason: List the files or modules the change may touch. An empty scope lets edits spread unreviewed, so declare the agreed boundary.

maximal.reason: State the compatibility expectations for existing callers or data. Leaving them implicit hides breaking changes, so record what must keep working.
